related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and authority-scope regression suite

request.operation: relate base-intent checkout continuity pressure to verified implementation

outcome.implemented_behavior: A previously composed base-intent checkout can remain available as identity-verified observation context across claim release and branch/HEAD refresh. The projection reports it as observed and leaves claim eligibility to the existing rights and live-conflict checks.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: Implementation and immediate regression behavior are verified; longitudinal intervention reduction remains unmeasured.
outcome.source_relationship_basis: This record links the exact committed implementation, independently executable regression file, and the campaign observation that records the pressure and resulting behavior.

pressure_hypothesis.title: A valid base-intent checkout can disappear between claim release and safe reacquisition
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment checkout composition and worktree claim acquisition
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The prior composition path required a live same-session claim to retain a base-intent checkout. Claim refresh can trigger revalidation after branch or HEAD drift before the next claim exists.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain a prior base-intent checkout as observation-only context after claim release when its registered path and stable checkout identities still match; refresh branch and HEAD, keep it out of claim eligibility, and preserve ordinary rights and live-conflict checks.
not_measured: agent time or tool calls avoided over subsequent work
whether later agents discover the retained read context without additional guidance

improvement_relation.basis: The exact implementation commit retains verified read context without adding claim eligibility. The full authority-scope regression suite verifies HEAD refresh and successful claim reacquisition while preserving rejection of a foreign overlapping claim. The original campaign observation and its append-only correction preserve the source context and limitations.
not_measured: agent intervention or total tool-call reduction
long-term outcomes after later sessions use the updated mechanism
whether this improvement reduces environmental intervention in later real sessions
whether the issue recurs in other base-intent repositories or checkout layouts
whether this change measurably affects MNCS-language adoption or unrelated environmental services
